notes.title: v1.7.4b1087 Release Notes
notes.content:
* Player names in better positions around table.
* Fix bug with support form.
* Fix bug with old tables sometimes showing in Browse Tables.
* Fix bug with initial match connections sometimes requiring reconnect.
* Lobby buttons now disable to avoid accidental double-clicks.
